run_setup_torchkin: run the setup.py to install the torchkin package with pip
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file and return a list of stripped dependency strings
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to check package metadata, dependencies, and classifiers
refactor_parse_requirements: refactor parse_requirements_file to skip blank lines and comments in requirements
summarize_setup_metadata: summarize the torchkin package metadata including version, author, and install requirements
